P.text: During market init, lastETWAPBaseSupply is seeded to 0, and the first mint does not update the stored exponential TWAP before _checkMintCap enforces limits.
P.evidence_quote: the exchange state seeds `lastETWAPBaseSupply` to `0`, and the first mint does not update the stored exponential TWAP before `_checkMintCap` enforces limits

I.text: Mint cap check should compare live supply against a properly updated ETWAP so that mints after crossing the noCapLimit threshold are not blocked.
I.evidence_quote: the system compares the live supply against a near-zero TWAP, so any follow-up mint after the threshold must fail until the ETWAP catches up

V.text: The first minter to cross the noCapLimit threshold permanently trips the mint cap, causing E_LEX_MintCapExceeded reverts and blocking new deposits for all users until the ETWAP decays/recovers.
V.evidence_quote: the first minter to cross the `noCapLimit` threshold will permanently trip the mint cap until the ETWAP decays
